answer: Each collapsed cluster gets one kernel weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. Because of that, an adversary who spins up 91 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 21 times the capital for one share. The whisper report makes public the merge explicitly at each nadir. A farm of 1703 identities would post 3836 proofs and burn roughly 4 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
